niche: an English integrated care board placing its 2027-28 additional elective lumbar decompression and discectomy operations with providers in order of each provider's case-mix adjusted 12-month disability improvement across every patient it operated on in 2023-25, from a spinal outcomes programme whose 12-month questionnaires go unanswered far more often after a complication that shows only as a later spell in the board's hospital episode extract
answer: Place 910 of the 1,250 additional 2027-28 operations with five providers (Hethercombe Park Hospital 180, Cragsmoor General Hospital 150, Shelderwick Hospital 260, Ravensholt Royal Infirmary 210, Corriemoor Penderwick House Hospital 110) and hold 340 for in-year commissioning
analyst_test: A strong analyst who links every questionnaire, scores the disability index correctly and applies the board's filed case-mix model computes each provider's adjusted improvement on the patients who returned the 12-month questionnaire (or fills the others from their pre-operative case-mix, on which answerers and non-answerers balance) and places the volume with the providers whose complicated patients went unanswered, overstating them by up to about two points and funding the wrong slate.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each provider's case-mix adjusted outcome across every patient it operated on, the provider-quality estimate the field makes by indirect standardisation against a risk model; what decides it is how the 12-month non-answerers are estimated, and the complications that both silence them and lower their outcome run through emergency readmissions and further spinal operations in the hospital episode data, so with another field's nouns (a school's pupils, a store's customers) there is no complication, readmission or reoperation for a follow-up questionnaire to go unanswered after.

driver: The decisive quantity is each group's mean change across every member it treated, observed only for the members who answered a follow-up, when members whose course went wrong answer far less and change far less and that course shows only as a later event in a second record; reading the change on the answerers, adjusted for each member's starting state or with the non-answerers filled from it, overstates the groups with the most such events, and only filling each non-answerer from the answerers who shared its later event counts them.
driver_concrete: Each provider's case-mix adjusted 12-month Oswestry Disability Index improvement over every eligible index operation, where the 12-month questionnaire comes back from about seven in ten patients but about a third of those readmitted as an emergency within 90 days of discharge (visible only as later spells in the board's hospital episode extract, often at another hospital), whose change is about 17 points below expected, so the answerers' adjusted mean overstates the complication-heavy providers by up to about 1.7 points; each non-answerer's improvement is taken from the answerers at its provider who shared its readmission status.
stump: A competent solver computes each provider's adjusted improvement on the patients who returned the 12-month questionnaire (or fills the others from their pre-operative case-mix), ranks the complication-heavy providers near the top and places the 2027-28 volume with them, when their non-answerers are disproportionately the patients readmitted or operated on again after a complication, whose improvement is far lower; filling each non-answerer from the answerers who shared its complication status drops them below the providers the default leaves out.

differentiation.task264: architecture 2 turned an exit survey's sample of visits into a count of people by each respondent's visit count; architecture 3 completes each provider's mean over every patient when follow-up non-response runs with complications recorded in another file
differentiation.task275: task275 rebuilds unobserved fishing trips' discards from their own effort by ground because being observed changes behaviour; task264 fills patients who did not answer a follow-up from answerers who shared their complication status, the complication both lowering the outcome and silencing the answer
differentiation.task281: task281 carries a validation batch's hit rate to each clinic through a hidden camera mix recovered from a register; task264 has no transport between populations: the providers' own patients are the population and the step is how their non-answerers are estimated
differentiation.task182: task182 v4 reads a duration distribution from snapshots of items still in progress, each entering in proportion to its own length; task264's records are complete operations and the selection is who answered a follow-up, carried by a complication recorded in another file
differentiation.task265: task265 admits units to the risk set only from when the record first saw them (left truncation of a survival curve); task264 has no time-to-event: it estimates the follow-up change of patients who did not answer from answerers who shared their complication status
differentiation.task452: task452 weights reference points by the inclusion probabilities of the map classes they were drawn from after the map was revised; task264's patients are a census of operations and the missing outcome is a non-answer driven by a later complication
differentiation.task139: task139 v1 reads a randomised intervention per assigned unit rather than per recorded costly case; task264 has no intervention or arm: it completes a provider's mean over every patient when complications silence the follow-up
differentiation.task270: task270 v1 corrects correlations for a pick made in rank order of a weighted sum and v6 places items sold without a slot by where they landed; task264 fills follow-up non-answers from answerers sharing a complication shown only as a later spell

lineage.driver: The decisive unit is the one that sets the value: averaging records across setters lets volume moving between dearer and cheaper setters pass for a change in the value, and splitting one setter's single value across its outlets keeps only the outlet-periods with a transaction, so the comparisons lose the slowly traded items and follow the busy ones.
lineage.architecture: v1 (a grocery scanner price index's 2027 publication structure: each category's change in four store formats, each line followed at the chain that prices it)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-17: the first determinism pass found the call deterministic (FIX_NOW on four ask forks); the one re-judge returned SEND_BACK (competing_defensible_answer): the methodology never says what a product is, so a literal reader prices each line store by store (7 categories) and the golden's line at its chain (10) holds only under an unfiled product definition; filing it would make the decisive step rule application

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many different members of each group a population of repeated events contains, seen only through a sample of the events in which each member is drawn in proportion to how many events it makes; reading the sampled members as the members, or dividing each group's estimated events by its sampled members' average event count, gives the groups whose members repeat most too many or too few, and only weighting each sampled member by its design weight over its own event count counts them.
lineage.niche: a joint regional park authority in England apportioning its 2027-28 levy among its nine member councils by the number of each council's adult residents who visited its parks in the 2025-26 survey year, each counted once, estimated from an on-site exit survey that draws adults as they leave on sampled days
lineage.fate: re-rooted 2026-11-01 at the Batch 3 queue reset (shipped 2026-10-17, no portal result; the park-levy world is closed)
